test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'MAIDEN' is written as 'ADEIMN', and 'SILVER' is written as 'EILRSV'. How will 'MAGNET' be written in that language?
solution:
**Concept: **Letters are in increasing alphabetical order. 

 **Solution:**

 
• 'MAIDEN' is written as 'ADEIMN'.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f3bb6c112bc18daa58670bf9dc6ccd35eb3658c7fdf9403cffd7fe60de1d5f4.png] 
 
• 'SILVER' is written as 'EILRSV'.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58ea65306b01db0838d11a395aaa5dd6ebfc6aa0b06124c32d6c83d93d4b7d3e.png] 
 
• Therefore,**MAGNET** will be written as** AEGMNT**.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5f1bf33df344a68f015aba01f75d67aa571bc5ce82723a3a637f98955796997.png] 

*Thus, the **correct answer i**s** option4.***
